story.title: Scent, told like a poem
story.p1: At Lunelle, a fragrance is more than something you wear. It is a mood, a memory, a small poem you carry on your skin.
story.p2: Our mists, musks and perfumes are soft and romantic: clean freshness, white flowers, warm vanilla and the quiet glow of moonlight.
story.p3: From the name on the bottle to the way it reaches your door, every detail is meant to feel gentle, and a little bit magical.

call.title: Confirmed with a call
call.text: Every order is confirmed by phone, within 24 hours.

delivery.title: Your door, an office or hand-to-hand
delivery.text: Home delivery, pick-up at a Yalidine office, or a free meeting in person.

payment.title: Pay when it arrives
payment.text: Cash only, when you receive your order. Nothing to pay online.

faq.title: Good to know
faq.subtitle: The answers to the questions we hear most. Anything else? Message us, we love hearing from you.

account.q: Do I need an account to order?
account.a: No. Add your favourites to the cart, then enter your name, phone number and delivery details at checkout. There is nothing to sign up for.

payment.a: You pay in cash when you receive your order: at the hand-over, at your door, or when you collect it at the Yalidine office. Nothing is paid online.

afterOrder.q: What happens after I place my order?
afterOrder.a: We call you within 24 hours to confirm your order. Please keep your phone nearby, and check that the number you entered is correct.

delivery.q: How does delivery work, and how much does it cost?
delivery.a: Choose hand-to-hand (free, we arrange the meeting place by phone), home delivery, or pick-up at a Yalidine office. The fee depends on your wilaya and the delivery type, and you see the exact total before you confirm.

tracking.a: Yes. Open “Track my order” at the bottom of the page and enter your order number with the phone number you ordered with.

packs.a: A pack is a set of products sold together for less than buying each piece separately. Its contents are fixed, and the pack page shows exactly how much you save.

stock.q: What if a product is out of stock?
stock.a: Out-of-stock products stay on the site but can't be added to your cart until they are available again.

contact.a: You will find our contact details and social media at the bottom of this page. Message us any time.

form.featuredHint: Shown in the “Best sellers” section of the home page.
